#DataEngineering #EnterpriseTech #CloudInnovation #DataOps #Snowflake  

Data Engineer at NexaCorp, turning raw data into actionable insights. Specialize in building scalable pipelines that power enterprise analytics—think Snowflake integrations, real-time processing, and cost-effective cloud strategies.  

When I’m not optimizing ETL workflows or debugging Kafka streams, I’m designing architectures that balance speed and reliability. My go-to tools? Airflow for orchestration, Spark for heavy lifting, and Docker/Terraform for reproducible environments. Cloud cost optimization? That’s just part of the daily grind.  

I thrive in fast-paced environments where data drives decisions. Whether it’s refining data models for better performance or ensuring warehouses scale with business needs, I’m all about delivering value.  

Looking to collaborate on projects that push boundaries and deliver measurable impact. Let’s build something awesome.  

*Data engineering isn’t just a job—it’s a mission to make data work.*
